description: This file defines test fixtures, utility classes, and functions for end-to-end testing of the Mattermost application using Playwright. It includes setup for extended fixtures, custom test classes, and integration with axe-core for accessibility testing.

classes.name: PlaywrightExtended
classes.description: Extended test fixture class providing access to various utilities, page objects, and setup functions for end-to-end testing.

classes.name: AxeBuilderExtended
classes.description: Wrapper around axe-core's AxeBuilder to facilitate accessibility testing with custom configurations.

methods.name: waitUntilLocalStorageIsSet
methods.description: Utility function that waits until a specific localStorage key is set to a given value within a timeout.
